scenario: A CI system requests AWS access to deploy; the default answer is an OIDC identity provider plus a role with a conditioned trust policy, previewed as exact JSON; generating an IAM user with access keys is refused as the default, allowed only as an explicit, labeled, expiring exception.

given.request: CI needs credentials to deploy into the target account

context.federation: supported in the detected account context (probe result)

when: the onboarding advisor assembles the credential recommendation

reasons: an OIDC identity provider is created for the CI issuer and the pipeline assumes a role via web identity
the trust policy carries conditions constraining the audience and subject claims to the specific pipeline, previewed as exact JSON with named principals
verification assumes the role from CI, attempts an out-of-scope action, and confirms the deny; policy versions are recorded for rollback
must_not: create an IAM user with long-lived access keys as the default
issue any static key without an explicit, labeled, expiring exception record with an owner and rotation duty
leave the trust policy without audience and subject conditions
